The court will most likely require a greater foundation (B). The defendant's testimony that he kept the records regularly satisfies only part of the business-records exception, and computer-generated data needs a showing that the process producing it is reliable, which he has not made. Option A states just one element, and C and D are wrong because the defendant's availability as a witness does not cure hearsay and no computer-process reliability has been shown.

CONFIDENCE: 72
